# STA2ASM Week 8: Bayesian inference explorer # Shinylive-friendly: only shiny and Base R. No package installation at runtime. library(shiny) PAL <- list(teal="#236A6E", blue="#174F8A", rose="#C65D7B", purple="#8064A2", grey="#666666", pale="#EEF5F5") fmt <- function(x, digits=3) formatC(x, format="f", digits=digits) # Render mathematical notation in dynamic and static Shiny content. mj <- function(s) withMathJax(HTML(s)) # Numerically integrate a curve and obtain its central posterior quantiles. trap_area <- function(x, y) sum(diff(x) * (head(y,-1) + tail(y,-1))/2) curve_quantile <- function(x, density, probs) { cumulative <- c(0, cumsum(diff(x)*(head(density,-1)+tail(density,-1))/2)) cumulative <- cumulative / tail(cumulative,1) approx(cumulative, x, xout=probs, ties="ordered")$y } # Two-sided Bayesian one-sample t-test based on the noncentral t likelihood. # The effect-size prior location can be changed independently of the null value. bayes_t <- function(x, family="Cauchy", scale=1/sqrt(2), prior_df=3, mu_null=0, prior_location=0) { n <- length(x) t_obs <- (mean(x)-mu_null)/(sd(x)/sqrt(n)) df <- n-1 d <- seq(min(-12,prior_location-12*scale),max(12,prior_location+12*scale),length.out=3001) prior <- switch(family, "Cauchy"=dcauchy(d,prior_location,scale), "Normal"=dnorm(d,prior_location,scale), "Student's t"=dt((d-prior_location)/scale,df=prior_df)/scale) # dt() is a density in the observed test statistic, evaluated for each delta. likelihood <- dt(t_obs,df=df,ncp=d*sqrt(n)) product <- prior*likelihood marginal_h1 <- trap_area(d,product) posterior <- product/marginal_h1 marginal_h0 <- dt(t_obs,df=df) bf10 <- marginal_h1/marginal_h0 q <- curve_quantile(d,posterior,c(.025,.5,.975)) negative <- trap_area(d[d<=0],posterior[d<=0]) prior0 <- switch(family, "Cauchy"=dcauchy(0,prior_location,scale), "Normal"=dnorm(0,prior_location,scale), "Student's t"=dt((0-prior_location)/scale,df=prior_df)/scale) post0 <- prior0*marginal_h0/marginal_h1 list(delta=d,prior=prior,likelihood=likelihood,product=product, posterior=posterior,t=t_obs,bf10=bf10,prior0=prior0,post0=post0, q=q,negative=negative,n=n) } # Normal-normal model, with known observation SD, for the prior-sensitivity tab. update_normal <- function(mu0, prior_sd, sample_mean, n, sigma=15) { v0 <- prior_sd^2 v <- 1/(1/v0+n/sigma^2) c(mean=v*(mu0/v0+n*sample_mean/sigma^2),sd=sqrt(v)) } # Draw a filled density curve without introducing a plotting package. draw_curve <- function(x,y,col,heading,ylab="Density",xlab=expression(delta), ylim=NULL,zero=TRUE) { if(is.null(ylim)) ylim <- c(0,max(y)*1.30) plot(x,y,type="n",main=heading,xlab=xlab,ylab=ylab,ylim=ylim,las=1,bty="l") polygon(c(x,rev(x)),c(y,rep(0,length(y))),col=adjustcolor(col,alpha.f=.13),border=NA) lines(x,y,col=col,lwd=2.5) if(zero) { abline(v=0,col="#555555",lty=2,lwd=1.8) legend("topright",legend=expression(H[0]*":"~delta==0), col="#555555",lty=2,lwd=1.8,bty="n",cex=0.83, inset=c(0.07,0.02),x.intersp=0.65) } } ui <- fluidPage( tags$head(tags$style(HTML(' body {font-family:"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;color:#333;background:#fff;} h1,h2,h3,h4 {color:#236A6E;font-weight:500;} .navbar-default {background:white;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #dce6e6;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;} .navbar-default .navbar-nav>.active>a,.navbar-default .navbar-nav>.active>a:hover {background:#EEF5F5;color:#236A6E;border-bottom:3px solid #236A6E;} .well {background:#EEF5F5;border:1px solid #cfdfe0;border-left:4px solid #236A6E;} .btn-primary {background:#236A6E;border-color:#236A6E;} .result {background:#EEF5F5;border-left:4px solid #236A6E;padding:12px 16px;margin:12px 0;} .note {color:#58696a;font-size:13px;margin:10px 0;} table.asm-table {width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:12px 0;} table.asm-table th,table.asm-table td {padding:9px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #dce6e6;text-align:left;} table.asm-table th {color:#236A6E;background:#EEF5F5;} .shiny-plot-output {max-width:100%;} .bf-highlight {border:1px solid #dce6e6;border-radius:7px;background:#fafcfc;padding:12px 16px;margin:12px 0 18px;} .bf-heading {font-weight:600;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:9px;color:#333;} .bf-label {font-size:12px;color:#667578;margin-bottom:3px;} .bf-number {font-size:21px;line-height:1.45;} .bf-conclusion {font-size:13px;color:#58696a;margin-top:8px;} '))), titlePanel("STA2ASM - Week 8: Bayesian Inference"), withMathJax(), p(class="note","Explore Bayesian updating, compare inference methods and investigate the influence of prior information."), navbarPage(title=NULL,id="tab",collapsible=TRUE, tabPanel(mj("Bayesian \\(t\\)-test explorer"), fluidRow( column(3,wellPanel( h4("Generate observations"), numericInput("pop_mean",mj("Population mean \\(\\mu\\)"),-8,step=1), numericInput("pop_sd",mj("Population SD \\(\\sigma\\)"),15,min=.1,step=1), numericInput("sample_n",mj("Sample size \\(n\\)"),30,min=3,max=500,step=1), actionButton("new_sample","Generate new sample",class="btn-primary"), tags$hr(),h4("Hypothesis test"), numericInput("mu_null",mj("Hypothesised mean \\(\\mu_0\\)"),0,step=1), uiOutput("hypotheses"), tags$hr(),h4(mj("Prior for standardised effect \\(\\delta\\)")), selectInput("prior_family",mj("Prior distribution for \\(\\delta\\)"),c("Cauchy","Normal","Student's t")), numericInput("prior_location",mj("Prior centre \\(\\delta_{\\mathrm{prior}}\\)"),0,step=.1), sliderInput("prior_scale",mj("Prior SD (Normal) / scale (Cauchy or Student's \\(t\\))"), min=.15,max=2.5,value=1/sqrt(2),step=.01), conditionalPanel("input.prior_family == \"Student's t\"", numericInput("prior_df",mj("Prior degrees of freedom \\(\\nu\\)"),3,min=1,max=30,step=1)), actionButton("restore_prior","Restore default Cauchy prior"), tags$hr(), p(class="note","Bootstrap inference uses B = 1,000 resamples for each generated sample.") )), column(9, h3("Observed sample"),uiOutput("sample_summary"), uiOutput("bf_highlight"), h3("Visualising the Bayesian components"), fluidRow(column(6,plotOutput("prior_plot",height="285px")), column(6,plotOutput("likelihood_plot",height="285px"))), fluidRow(column(6,plotOutput("product_plot",height="285px")), column(6,plotOutput("posterior_plot",height="285px"))), h3("Prior and posterior: Savage-Dickey"), uiOutput("bayes_summary"), fluidRow( column(4,checkboxInput("show_cri","Shade central 95% credible interval",TRUE)), column(4,checkboxInput("show_direction","Shade directional posterior probability",FALSE)), column(4,radioButtons("direction",mj("Direction for \\(\\delta\\)"), choices=c("Below zero"="negative","Above zero"="positive"), selected="negative",inline=TRUE)) ), plotOutput("combined_plot",height="430px"), h3("Comparison of inference methods"), uiOutput("comparison") ) ) ), tabPanel("Prior sensitivity and sample size", fluidRow( column(3,wellPanel( h4("Prior sensitivity"), selectInput("scenario","Prior presets",choices=c( "Broad prior"="broad","Moderately informative"="moderate", "Informative, conflicting"="conflict","Strongly informative, conflicting"="strong", "Custom"="custom")), p(class="note", "Choose a preset to set the prior mean and SD, or adjust them to create a custom prior."), numericInput("prior_mu",mj("Prior mean \\(\\mu_0\\)"),0,step=1), sliderInput("prior_sd",mj("Prior SD \\(\\sigma_0\\)"),min=1,max=30,value=20,step=.5), numericInput("observed_mu",mj("Observed sample mean \\(\\bar{x}\\)"),-9,step=1), numericInput("known_sigma",mj("Assumed known population SD \\(\\sigma\\)"),15,min=.1,step=1), sliderInput("n_small",mj("Small sample size \\(n_1\\)"),min=3,max=40,value=5,step=1), sliderInput("n_large",mj("Large sample size \\(n_2\\)"),min=40,max=300,value=100,step=5), mj("

The observed sample mean \\(\\bar{x}\\) is held constant across sample sizes, isolating the influence of the prior and sample size.

") )), column(9, h3("How prior information changes the posterior"), mj("

This tab uses a normal-normal model with known population standard deviation \\(\\sigma\\), as in the readings. It is different from the noncentral \\(t\\) model in Tab 1.

"), plotOutput("sensitivity_plot",height="475px"), uiOutput("sensitivity_summary"), mj("

The posterior combines the prior and the observed data. A strongly informative prior can dominate a small sample, even when the prior conflicts with the observed sample mean \\(\\bar{x}\\).

") ) ) ) ) ) server <- function(input,output,session) { # The initial simulated dataset retains the Week 8 numerical defaults. sample_data <- eventReactive(list(input$new_sample,input$pop_mean,input$pop_sd,input$sample_n),{ if(input$new_sample==0 && input$pop_mean==-8 && input$pop_sd==15 && input$sample_n==30) set.seed(512) rnorm(as.integer(input$sample_n),mean=input$pop_mean,sd=input$pop_sd) },ignoreNULL=FALSE) observeEvent(input$restore_prior,{ updateSelectInput(session,"prior_family",selected="Cauchy") updateSliderInput(session,"prior_scale",value=1/sqrt(2)) updateNumericInput(session,"prior_df",value=3) updateNumericInput(session,"prior_location",value=0) }) analysis <- reactive({ req(sample_data(),input$prior_family,input$prior_scale,input$prior_location) bayes_t(sample_data(),input$prior_family,input$prior_scale, if(is.null(input$prior_df)) 3 else input$prior_df, mu_null=input$mu_null,prior_location=input$prior_location) }) boot_result <- eventReactive(list(sample_data(),input$mu_null),{ x <- sample_data(); n <- length(x); B <- 1000 # Ordinary percentile bootstrap CI for the population mean. means <- replicate(B,mean(sample(x,n,replace=TRUE))) ci <- unname(quantile(means,c(.025,.975))) # Null-centred bootstrap test, studentised on each resample. x0 <- x-mean(x)+input$mu_null t0 <- replicate(B,{ xb <- sample(x0,n,replace=TRUE) (mean(xb)-input$mu_null)/(sd(xb)/sqrt(n)) }) tobs <- (mean(x)-input$mu_null)/(sd(x)/sqrt(n)) p <- (1+sum(abs(t0)>=abs(tobs)))/(B+1) list(ci=ci,p=p) },ignoreNULL=FALSE) output$hypotheses <- renderUI({ req(input$mu_null) mj(sprintf(paste0( "
Two-sided hypotheses
", "\\(H_0:\\mu=%s\\)   vs   \\(H_1:\\mu\\ne %s\\)
", "Equivalently, for \\(\\delta=(\\mu-\\mu_0)/\\sigma\\):
", "\\(H_0:\\delta=0\\)   vs   \\(H_1:\\delta\\ne0\\)
"), fmt(input$mu_null),fmt(input$mu_null))) }) output$sample_summary <- renderUI({ x <- sample_data() mj(sprintf( "
\\(n=%d\\)   |   Sample mean: \\(\\bar{x}=%s\\)   |   Sample SD: \\(s=%s\\)   |   \\(t_{%d}=%s\\)
", length(x),fmt(mean(x)),fmt(sd(x)),length(x)-1,fmt(analysis()$t))) }) output$prior_plot <- renderPlot({ a<-analysis(); draw_curve(a$delta,a$prior,PAL$blue,"1. Prior") }) output$likelihood_plot <- renderPlot({ a<-analysis(); draw_curve(a$delta,a$likelihood,PAL$rose,"2. Likelihood","Likelihood") }) output$product_plot <- renderPlot({ a<-analysis(); draw_curve(a$delta,a$product,PAL$grey,"3. Prior x likelihood","Unscaled density") }) # The four components use a common scale to show how updating works. # Posterior annotations and shaded probabilities are reserved for the larger plot. output$posterior_plot <- renderPlot({ a <- analysis() draw_curve(a$delta,a$posterior,PAL$teal,"4. Posterior") }) output$combined_plot <- renderPlot({ a <- analysis() d <- a$delta # Adaptive limits: include the central 84% of the prior, almost all of # the posterior, and delta = 0 for the Savage-Dickey markers. # This avoids displaying the uninformative extreme tails of a Cauchy prior. prior_bounds <- switch(input$prior_family, "Cauchy"=qcauchy(c(.08,.92),location=input$prior_location,scale=input$prior_scale), "Normal"=qnorm(c(.08,.92),mean=input$prior_location,sd=input$prior_scale), "Student's t"=input$prior_location + input$prior_scale * qt(c(.08,.92),df=if(is.null(input$prior_df)) 3 else input$prior_df)) post_bounds <- a$q[c(1,3)] # Extend the posterior interval to cover almost all its mass. post_bounds <- curve_quantile(d,a$posterior,c(.001,.999)) xr <- range(c(0,prior_bounds,post_bounds)) pad <- max(diff(xr)*.10,0.12) xlim <- xr + c(-pad,pad) visible <- d >= xlim[1] & d <= xlim[2] ylim <- c(0,max(c(a$prior[visible],a$posterior[visible], a$prior0,a$post0))*1.22) plot(d,a$prior,type="n",xlim=xlim,ylim=ylim, xlab=expression("Standardised effect "*delta),ylab="Probability density", main="Prior and posterior under H1",las=1,bty="l") # Shade the central 95% credible interval (equal-tailed). if(isTRUE(input$show_cri)) { xs <- sort(unique(c(a$q[1],d[d>a$q[1] & d 0 | data, H1). if(isTRUE(input$show_direction)) { bounds <- if(input$direction=="positive") c(0,max(d)) else c(min(d),0) xs <- sort(unique(c(bounds[1],d[d>bounds[1] & d= 1) "H_1" else "H_0" main_bf <- if (bf >= 1) "\\text{BF}_{10}" else "\\text{BF}_{01}" other_bf <- if (bf >= 1) "\\text{BF}_{01}" else "\\text{BF}_{10}" main_value <- max(bf, 1/bf) other_value <- min(bf, 1/bf) strength <- if (main_value > 100) "Decisive" else if (main_value >= 30) "Very strong" else if (main_value >= 10) "Strong" else if (main_value >= 3) "Moderate" else "Anecdotal" message <- if (abs(bf-1) < 1e-8) "Equal evidence for both hypotheses." else sprintf("%s evidence in favour of \\(%s\\).", strength, preferred) div(class="bf-highlight", tags$div(class="bf-heading", "Bayesian hypothesis test"), fluidRow( column(6, tags$div(class="bf-label", if (bf >= 1) "Evidence favouring H1" else "Evidence favouring H0"), mj(sprintf("
\\(%s=%s\\)
", main_bf, fmt(main_value))) ), column(6, tags$div(class="bf-label", "Reciprocal"), mj(sprintf("
\\(%s=%s\\)
", other_bf, fmt(other_value))) ) ), mj(sprintf("
%s
", message)) ) }) output$bayes_summary <- renderUI({ a<-analysis(); bf<-a$bf10; probh1<-bf/(1+bf) direction_prob <- if(input$direction=="positive") 1-a$negative else a$negative direction_sign <- if(input$direction=="positive") ">" else "<" div(class="result", tags$strong("Bayesian hypothesis testing"),tags$br(), withMathJax(HTML(sprintf( "\\(\\text{BF}_{10}=%s\\), \\(\\text{BF}_{01}=%s\\). With prior odds 1:1, \\(P(H_1\\mid\\mathrm{data})=%s\\) and \\(P(H_0\\mid\\mathrm{data})=%s\\).", fmt(bf),fmt(1/bf),fmt(probh1),fmt(1-probh1)))), tags$br(),tags$br(),tags$strong("Savage-Dickey density ratio"),tags$br(), mj(sprintf("Prior density at \\(\\delta=0\\) = %s; posterior density at \\(\\delta=0\\) = %s; their ratio = %s (\\(\\text{BF}_{10}\\)).", fmt(a$prior0,5),fmt(a$post0,5),fmt(a$prior0/a$post0,3))), tags$br(),tags$br(),mj("Posterior estimation, conditional on \\(H_1\\)"),tags$br(), withMathJax(HTML(sprintf( "Median of \\(\\delta\\): %s. Central 95%% credible interval: (%s, %s). \\(P(\\delta%s0\\mid\\mathrm{data},H_1)=%s\\).", fmt(a$q[2]),fmt(a$q[1]),fmt(a$q[3]),direction_sign,fmt(direction_prob,4)))) ) }) output$comparison <- renderUI({ x <- sample_data(); tr <- t.test(x,mu=input$mu_null); br <- boot_result(); a <- analysis() prob_h1 <- a$bf10/(1+a$bf10) # Display the Bayes factor favouring the better-supported model first. preferred_bf <- if (a$bf10 >= 1) { sprintf("\\text{BF}_{10}=%s", fmt(a$bf10)) } else { sprintf("\\text{BF}_{01}=%s", fmt(1/a$bf10)) } reciprocal_bf <- if (a$bf10 >= 1) { sprintf("\\text{BF}_{01}=%s", fmt(1/a$bf10)) } else { sprintf("\\text{BF}_{10}=%s", fmt(a$bf10)) } strength_value <- max(a$bf10, 1/a$bf10) strength <- if (strength_value > 100) "Decisive" else if (strength_value >= 30) "Very strong" else if (strength_value >= 10) "Strong" else if (strength_value >= 3) "Moderate" else "Anecdotal" preferred_h <- if (a$bf10 >= 1) "H_1" else "H_0" evidence_label <- if (abs(a$bf10 - 1) < 1e-8) "Equal evidence for both hypotheses" else sprintf("%s evidence in favour of \\(%s\\)", strength, preferred_h) bf_text <- sprintf("\\(%s;\\ %s\\). %s", preferred_bf, reciprocal_bf, evidence_label) directional <- if(input$direction=="positive") 1-a$negative else a$negative dir_sign <- if(input$direction=="positive") ">" else "<" # Under the normal sampling model with the reference non-informative # location-scale prior, the 95% CrI for mu equals the t confidence interval. mu_cri <- tr$conf.int rows <- list( c("Frequentist \\(t\\)-test", paste0("\\(p=",format.pval(tr$p.value,digits=3),"\\)"), sprintf("(%.2f, %.2f) for \\(\\mu\\)",tr$conf.int[1],tr$conf.int[2])), c("Bootstrap", paste0("\\(p=",format.pval(br$p,digits=3),"\\)"), sprintf("(%.2f, %.2f) for \\(\\mu\\)",br$ci[1],br$ci[2])), c("Bayesian \\(t\\)-test: effect size", sprintf("%s; \\(P(H_1\\mid\\mathrm{data})=%s\\); \\(P(\\delta%s0\\mid\\mathrm{data},H_1)=%s\\)", bf_text,fmt(prob_h1,3),dir_sign,fmt(directional,4)), sprintf("(%.3f, %.3f) for \\(\\delta\\)",a$q[1],a$q[3])), c("Bayesian: population mean", "Non-informative prior; same numerical interval as frequentist \\(t\\)-test CI", sprintf("(%.2f, %.2f) for \\(\\mu\\)",mu_cri[1],mu_cri[2])) ) mj(paste0( "", paste(vapply(rows,function(r) paste0("",paste0("",collapse=""),""),character(1)),collapse=""), "
MethodHypothesis test / posterior probability95% interval
",r,"
")) }) # Presets populate the controls; manually editing either control selects Custom. prior_presets <- list(broad=c(0,20), moderate=c(0,8), conflict=c(8,5), strong=c(15,3)) observeEvent(input$scenario, { if (identical(input$scenario, "custom")) return() values <- prior_presets[[input$scenario]] req(values) freezeReactiveValue(input, "prior_mu") freezeReactiveValue(input, "prior_sd") updateNumericInput(session, "prior_mu", value=values[1]) updateSliderInput(session, "prior_sd", value=values[2]) }, ignoreInit=TRUE) observeEvent(list(input$prior_mu, input$prior_sd), { selected <- input$scenario if (is.null(selected) || identical(selected, "custom")) return() expected <- prior_presets[[selected]] if (!is.null(expected) && (!isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(input$prior_mu), expected[1])) || !isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(input$prior_sd), expected[2])))) { updateSelectInput(session, "scenario", selected="custom") } }, ignoreInit=TRUE) sensitivity <- reactive({ req(input$prior_mu,input$prior_sd,input$observed_mu,input$known_sigma, input$n_small,input$n_large) small<-update_normal(input$prior_mu,input$prior_sd,input$observed_mu, input$n_small,input$known_sigma) large<-update_normal(input$prior_mu,input$prior_sd,input$observed_mu, input$n_large,input$known_sigma) list(small=small,large=large) }) output$sensitivity_plot <- renderPlot({ s<-sensitivity() centres<-c(input$prior_mu,input$observed_mu,s$small[1],s$large[1]) spreads<-c(input$prior_sd,input$known_sigma/sqrt(input$n_small), s$small[2],s$large[2]) lim<-range(centres+c(-1,1)*max(spreads)*3) d<-seq(lim[1],lim[2],length.out=1400) prior<-dnorm(d,input$prior_mu,input$prior_sd) psmall<-dnorm(d,s$small[1],s$small[2]) plarge<-dnorm(d,s$large[1],s$large[2]) plot(d,prior,type="l",col=PAL$blue,lwd=2.7,lty=2,las=1,bty="l", ylim=c(0,max(prior,psmall,plarge)*1.35), xlab="Population mean",ylab="Density", main="Prior and posterior distributions") lines(d,psmall,col=PAL$rose,lwd=2.7) lines(d,plarge,col=PAL$teal,lwd=2.7) abline(v=input$observed_mu,col="grey30",lty=2,lwd=1.8) legend("topright",legend=c("Prior",paste0("Posterior: n = ",input$n_small), paste0("Posterior: n = ",input$n_large), paste0("Observed mean = ",fmt(input$observed_mu,1))), col=c(PAL$blue,PAL$rose,PAL$teal,"grey30"), lty=c(2,1,1,2),lwd=c(2.7,2.7,2.7,1.8),bty="n",cex=.9) }) output$sensitivity_summary <- renderUI({ s <- sensitivity() ci <- function(z) sprintf("(%.2f, %.2f)",z[1]-qnorm(.975)*z[2], z[1]+qnorm(.975)*z[2]) mj(sprintf(paste0( "
Posterior summaries", "

The mean below is the posterior mean \\(\\text{E}(\\mu\\mid\\mathrm{data})\\),", " our estimate of the population mean \\(\\mu\\), not the observed sample mean \\(\\bar{x}\\).

", "Small sample (\\(n=%d\\)): posterior mean \\(\\text{E}(\\mu\\mid\\mathrm{data})=%s\\); 95%% CrI = %s
", "Large sample (\\(n=%d\\)): posterior mean \\(\\text{E}(\\mu\\mid\\mathrm{data})=%s\\); 95%% CrI = %s", "
"), input$n_small,fmt(s$small[1]),ci(s$small), input$n_large,fmt(s$large[1]),ci(s$large))) }) } shinyApp(ui,server)
